title: Advertiser Learning in Direct Advertising Markets
authors: Carl F. Mela; Jason M.T. Roos; Tulio Sousa
eligible_reason: Structural Bayesian advertiser-learning model of direct-buy ad subscriptions (Stan/cmdstan), with counterfactual simulations of information pooling. No binary staggered treatment and no TWFE DiD; the only fixest call (footnote 14) is a cross-sectional regression of log creatives on log non-repeated campaigns with advertiser and blog FE.
design_notes: manuscript.R reproduces all results from the lad3 R package; regressions are descriptive (log price on week, blog and length; clicks on CTRs) plus the structural learning model.
data_files_note: Ad-network data shipped inside the lad3 R package archive.
data_provenance_note: Data shipped in the R package; no statement of simulation or disguise.
software_notes: R with cmdstanr/Stan and a custom R package (lad3).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
